outcome: radiographic progression of spine (CT Syndesmophyte Score)
radiographic progression of sacroiliac joints (SIJ scores)
cohort: The study included women aged 19-49 years with radiographic axial spondyloarthritis (r-axSpA) who underwent at least two CT evaluations of the whole spine and/or sacroiliac joints.
finding: Pregnancy and delivery do not affect the radiographic progression of the spine and sacroiliac joints in women with r-axSpA as assessed by CT.
mod_finding: The changes in sacroiliac joint scores were comparable regardless of the delivery method.
